# MICPE addition - XAML core runtime.
#
# WimBuilder2 gets these from 01-Components/CredDialog/main.bat, where
# Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources%VER_XAMLRES%.dll expands to a wildcard for build
# 23000 and later (Projects/WIN10XPE/main.bat lines 55-63). The zp-UWPAppX and
# 00-Shell blocks that tools/Import-Wb2UwpChain.ps1 imports never reference
# Windows.UI.Xaml.dll itself, so without this list the chain "succeeds" and then
# every XAML host (ShellExperienceHost, StartMenuExperienceHost,
# ImmersiveControlPanel) fails to load at run time.
#
# Not generated by the importer on purpose: it is a deliberate extra, and a
# re-import must not silently drop it.
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Controls.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.XamlHost.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.19h1.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.21h1.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.Common.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.rs1.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.rs2.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.rs3.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.rs4.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.rs5.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.th.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.win81.dll
Windows/System32/Windows.UI.Xaml.Resources.win8rtm.dll
